references.name: front-oblique-2024.jpg
references.author: Fernando
references.observed: Actually inspected the complete north/east oblique: red brick main body over pale basement, pale attic band with alternating tall glazed windows and original geometric relief panels, heavy dentil cornice, dark low roof with brick chimneys. East principal portico has four tall pale fluted Doric columns, genuine open intercolumniation, a deep entablature and closed triangular pediment with simplified corner/peak figures. Broad entrance stairs and closed timber doors are partly obscured by railings/trees. North side has two rows of framed windows, a central secondary door and small balcony. No roof courtyard appears in map; rear details are inferred.

references.name: north-front-2017.jpg
references.author: Luis García
references.observed: Actually inspected the full north frontage: eleven bays on both brick stories, central closed secondary door with small stone balcony above, alternating triangular and horizontal upper window heads, continuous pale belt/base courses, tall narrow attic windows alternating square relief panels, dentil cornice and several brick chimneys. Ground and basement follow a slight street slope. Exact sculptural/lettered detail is omitted in favor of original geometric interpretation.

note: Ordinary pictures are local visual references only; they are not redistributed or used as textures. No bespoke research.
